review.imagery: Root reviewed all10 extracted resources and selected nine original brochure scenes. The lower-resolution duplicate cover crop and generic people/workspace photographs are excluded. Phase5 own frontage is on the card. Pool, gym and interior renders are expressly shared collection concepts.
review.floorPlans: Root reviewed all21 staged whole spreads and all30 enlarged visible residence footer panels. Twenty choices deliver every residence type and all building floors, plus project/community masters. Page28 final E2 differs from hidden1416 text. Page36 final C22408 and D11630–1652 differ from hidden2410/1657. F1/F2 reversed suite extrema remain disputed. Minimum-only qualifiers are preserved.
review.location: Root reviewed the exact Gate5 red footprint, complete regional portfolio map and all four community journey callouts. Building coordinates remain unavailable. No sales-office or camera-center coordinate is converted into a visitor entrance.
review.provenance: Official category HTML and the original93,611,465-byte October2025 brochure are cached with dated URLs, byte counts and SHA256. Every plan remains a complete unedited source spread with its notices and physical-page reference. Existing canonical research and protected identity are preserved.

unavailable: Exact visitor coordinates, kilometre routes and unit-specific current travel times remain unverified. F1/F2 suite extrema are reversed in the source. Hidden older engineering areas differ from final visible panels. Final unit-specific area, finishes and inventory require confirmation.
